shortDesc: Spreadsheet-to-VCF converter for batch contact imports.
fullDesc:
A data formatting utility designed to convert Excel (.xlsx) and CSV lists of contacts into standardized Virtual Contact Files (.vcf).

Core Idea:
The project simplifies importing large contact lists into mobile devices and email clients. It reads contact rows, parses fields (name, phone, email, organization), and formats them into VCF v3.0 standard files ready for bulk importing.
highlights: Converts thousands of rows of contacts into VCF standard in seconds
Generated files are compatible with all modern smartphones and email clients
